summary.name: ZombieHug (aizombie.app)
summary.one_liner: ZombieHug is a web tool that turns two uploaded photos into a 15-second vertical zombie love story video with several shots and sound, inspired by the viral AI zombie trend.
keywords: make zombie video from two photos
use_cases: Make a viral zombie hug video of you and a partner for TikTok or Reels
Create a 15-second vertical love story video from two photos
Send a personalized zombie love story video to someone far away
Produce a quick short-form video for social media without editing clips
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes two photos (Photo 1 holds the gun, Photo 2 turns into the zombie) and generates a single 15-second video with several shots and sound in one generation, with no prompts to write and no clips to stitch. Output options include 21:9, 16:9 or 9:16 aspect ratios and 480p or 720p resolution, with an optional line for a memory location. The story runs from a lowered gun in a cabin to a leap that cuts to a golden memory of the couple. The page says exported video has no watermark and that failed renders return credits automatically. Prices are shown per video, with one-time packs and optional subscriptions.
notable: Two photos to a 15-second zombie love story video with sound in one generation
Vertical 9:16 output aimed at TikTok, Reels and Shorts
No sign-up; one-time packs with optional monthly, quarterly or yearly subscriptions
Independent fan-style tool, not affiliated with CHOICE or filmmaker techmaf
caveats: Single 720p video costs $6.99 (listed as 30% off); packs and subscriptions cost more per bundle, and 480p uses more credits
Results vary per generation: shot count, motion and likeness may differ from the sample
Photos must be of adults 18+ with rights and consent; celebrities and babies are out of scope
